upstream_reference.summary: Answered under SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.60.3 (done). An omitted (reset ...) selects asynchronous active-low rst_n and reports origin legacy_default; an explicit reset reports explicit; a clock-only named domain has no reset, reports domain_absent, and guarantees no startup state or values. No form leaves reset policy unresolved until instantiation; SPECFORGE decides whether its adapter may accept the compiler default. The origin report needs a FSMGen revision newer than the pin.
